A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
candidate gene studies have not been very successful in finding genetic variants associated with MDD.
the GAIN MMD GWAS has not replicated any previously reported candidate genes for MDD.
there is no evidence to support a role in MDD for the majority of candidate genes that have been investigated in case–control association studies.

candidate gene studies in MDD should be interpreted cautiously.
